prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates performed better than predicted.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path hint, choose_path new_flow, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were helpful, winning in 5 of 9 tests (+9.4%, +5.6%, +4.3%, +4.4%, and +3.1%), while 4 showed no clear effect.
Sign-in wait info (sign_in wait_info) updates were consistently helpful, winning in both tests (+3.0% and +7.3%).
Home wait info (home wait_info) changes were helpful in 4 of 11 tests (+4.2%, +4.0%, +2.6%, and +2.7%), while the remaining 7 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests, while no clear effect was seen across tests for adoption copy, choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, and sign_in hint.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, wait_info] Sign-In Account Sync Diagnostic Wait Status: Adds real-time sign-in authentication and pet data cloud synchronization status indicators on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign_in wait_info has consistently performed well in previous tests (+3.0%, +7.3%).)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Direct Control Gesture Walkthrough Flow: Adds an interactive practice flow on the final onboarding screen teaching users how to right-click, summon, and hide their desktop companion. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding, and interactive finish flows have won in 5 prior tests.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Layering and Display Verification Progress Status: Displays a diagnostic system check on the waiting screen verifying desktop display layering and overlay compatibility before launching. (why: 3 support complaints mentioned pets failing to appear on desktop or app opening issues; home wait_info tests previously provided positive conversion lift (+4.2%).)
3: [finish, new_screen] Post-Setup Desktop Shortcut and Control Reference Screen: Adds a dedicated post-setup screen presenting key mouse gestures, hotkeys, and menu shortcuts to manage the desktop pet. (why: Support mail highlighted user confusion regarding how to control, summon, or hide the pet once setup completes.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality & Lighting Guidance Hint: Adds explicit guidance copy on the photo upload screen explaining photo framing and lighting requirements for accurate pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or producing incorrect visual results; adoption drop-off is highest at 72.3%.)
5: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Backup Account Security Incentive Callout: Adds a badge callout on the sign-in screen highlighting that signing in guarantees cloud pet backup and trait preservation. (why: 8 emails reported pets resetting or missing upon re-sign-in; emphasizing account data safety reduces sign-in drop-off.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Voice & Audio Call Test Flow: Adds an interactive audio sound-check component on the finish screen allowing users to test pet speech output and audio feedback. (why: Users expressed post-onboarding confusion regarding talking to the pet, and interactive finish flows have a high win rate (5 of 9 tests).)
7: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Data Backup Reassurance Copy: Updates headline and body text on the adoption certificate screen reassuring users their pet traits are permanently saved. (why: Adoption has the biggest drop in the funnel (72.3% conversion, median 89s / mean 1017s); copy reassuring progress retention helps completion.)
8: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence Shift: Moves sign-in after character adoption certificate so users pick and register their pet before account creation. (why: Adoption drop-off is high (72.3%). Allowing users to create and finalize their pet adoption certificate first increases emotional investment prior to sign-in.)
